name: Soroavisaurus
sum: Avisaurid enantiornithine from the Maastrichtian Lecho Formation of Argentina, named as the sister of Avisaurus.
wsnote: Body length estimated at about 40 cm; specimens vary in size (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: Hindlimb material from the Lecho Formation (number in Chiappe 1993).
biology: Probably a predator that used its sharp curved talons to carry prey.
author: Chiappe 1993
